## Goal

Remove the legacy `rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check` CLI/direct-engine command and its `.bridge_state/reconcile-check.json` status artifact without breaking the canonical bridge surfaces that replaced its observables.

Replacement is distributed:
- `rebar bridge preview` is the live Jira-vs-local differ/proposed-change observable.
- `rebar bridge fsck --output json` is the offline orphan/unbound/binding-drift audit observable.
- `rebar bridge status --json` remains the status surface, but no longer reads stale `reconcile-check.json`.

Preserve `_ref_lock.py` pause sentinel bytes: `gated_mode == "reconcile-check"` is not the CLI command.

## Scope

- `_bridge_runner.py`: repoint retained `reconcile-check` profile to `rebar bridge preview`, not fsck.
- `_cli/_registry.py`, `_cli/_parsers/advanced/reconcile.py`, `_cli/help/reconcile.txt`: remove top-level `rebar reconcile`, `--mode reconcile-check`, and `--filter-local-ids` CLI surface.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py`: delete `_run_reconcile_check`, its JSON writer, dispatch branch, and CLI-only `filter_local_ids` handoff.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/request.py`: remove legacy-route parsing; keep canonical `preview`/`sync`.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/mode.py`: remove `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK`, `_ORDERED` entry, and `MODE_CAPS` entry.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/_preflight.py`: remove reconcile-check no-write logic/wording.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/last_pass.py`: remove `_read_reconcile_diagnostics()` and `snapshot()["reconcile_diagnostics"]`.
- `_mcp_models.py`, `schemas/bridge_status.schema.json`, `types.py`: remove `reconcile_diagnostics` from BridgeStatus model/schema/types so MCP no longer advertises a producerless field.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile_check.py`: delete orphaned legacy report module.
- Update stale reconcile-check wording in `binding_recovery.py`, `binding_walk.py`, `fetcher.py`, `get_rotation.py`, `load_phase.py`, `pass_support.py`, `reconcile_helpers.py`, and `ticket_planner.py`.
- Update workflow/probe/docs/changelog references that instruct `reconcile-check`, using preview for live discrepancy checks and fsck for offline orphan/unbound audits.
- Update tests for removed command/module, BridgeStatus model/schema parity, preview-based probe assertions, and pause-sentinel preservation.

## Design Decisions

1. `bridge fsck` is not the sole replacement. It is offline and exits 1 for audit findings; legacy reconcile-check exited 0 when it successfully produced findings.
2. `_bridge_runner.MODE_COMMANDS["reconcile-check"]` maps to `rebar bridge preview`, whose canonical route emits JSON on stdout and `BRIDGE_STATE: <state>` on stderr with 0/1/2 exit semantics.
3. After `_run_reconcile_check` is deleted, no canonical writer refreshes `.bridge_state/reconcile-check.json`; remove all status/model/schema readers instead of creating a new writer.
4. Remove `BridgeStatusOut.reconcile_diagnostics` in `_mcp_models.py`; schema drift will not catch an extra permissive model field, so add explicit MCP/schema parity coverage.
5. Pressure probes must stop grepping legacy prose (`0 discrepancies`, `discrepancy`, `mismatch`). Run canonical `preview --only ... --repo-root ...`, preserve the exit code, parse the final stdout JSON, and pass only when `route=="preview"`, `mutation_count==0`, and `plan` contains no entry for the probe key/local id.
6. Keep `_ref_lock.py` pause sentinel `reconcile-check` byte-for-byte.
7. Do not remove dead internal `filter_local_ids` plumbing beyond CLI surface; follow-up `f8c4-ac9b-42c5-4bb0` owns that.
8. c195 has landed, so `_mcp_models.py` is safe in 82bb; do not re-edit `_lib_ops.py` or `_mcp_reads.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_mode.py` proves `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK`, `_ORDERED`, and `MODE_CAPS` entries are gone while remaining ordering works.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_main.py` proves `--mode reconcile-check` rejects and `_run_reconcile_check` is not dispatched.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py` proves the retained runner profile invokes `bridge preview`, not fsck, and preserves delivery semantics.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_fsck_binding_drift.py` proves orphaned bindings/Jira and unbound local/Jira remain in `bridge fsck --output json`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_heldout.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_relocated_store.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_programmatic_heldout.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_heldout.py` proves BridgeStatus library/MCP/schema/types no longer expose `reconcile_diagnostics`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/test_jira_pressure_probe_preview_assertions_heldout.py` proves both pressure probes migrated from legacy prose greps to preview JSON assertions on `route`, `mutation_count`, and absence of probe targets in `plan`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock_ref_backend.py` proves pause documents still preserve `gated_mode == "reconcile-check"`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_reconcile_check_cli_removal_heldout.py` proves removed CLI spelling is rejected and remaining `reconcile-check` hits are only pause-sentinel or historical/changelog references.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` passes.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test` passes.

## Testing

Held-out oracle: `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_reconcile_check_cli_removal_heldout.py`.

Probe oracle: `tests/scripts/test_jira_pressure_probe_preview_assertions_heldout.py`, checking:
- `e2e_validation_probe.sh` replaces Phase 5 `run_reconciler --mode reconcile-check` and `0 discrepancies`/`JIRA_KEY` grep fallback with scoped `preview --only "$LOCAL_ID"` JSON parsing.
- `e2e_field_validation_probe.sh` replaces Phase 7 per-key `discrepancy|mismatch` grep with scoped `preview --only "$FILTER_IDS"` JSON parsing over all probe keys/local ids.
- helper code preserves the reconciler exit code instead of masking it with `|| true`.

Run targeted pytest commands from Acceptance Criteria, then:
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`

## Out of scope

- Do not edit `_lib_ops.py` or `_mcp_reads.py`; c195 already removed Python/MCP `rebar.reconcile(mode=...)`.
- Do not remove engine `filter_local_ids` plumbing beyond CLI surface; `f8c4-ac9b-42c5-4bb0` owns it.
- Do not change `_ref_lock.py` pause sentinel bytes/schema.
- Do not change canonical preview/sync/fsck/status semantics except removing stale status diagnostics.
- Do not run plan-review, claim, close, or force any ticket for this work.
